name: Dynamic Workspaces
author: Dominik Mikolajczyk
description: Omarchy's workspace widget with profiles: per-monitor workspaces, grouped, named and ordered for each monitor setup.

barWidget.description: A control icon and a grouped workspace display, selectable per widget instance, so each sits where you want it on the bar.

schema.label: Widget mode
schema.description: Control shows the panel icon. Workspaces shows the workspaces grouped by monitor.

schema.label: Panel icon
schema.description: Any text, emoji, or Nerd Font glyph displayed on the bar.
